summary: Independent fresh-context review of the PXD008361 PBS-wash SDRF (19 runs: 6 AML patients x 0/1/2 PBS washes, minus P1/P4 2x, plus 3 QC-pool injections). Spec, ontology, file mapping, design and evidence checks pass; official validator passes with 3 expected free-text treatment warnings; two reconcile heuristic flags were adjudicated as false positives against the PRIDE record, paper and FASP reference. Only minor findings remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent reviewer (bergen-reviewer-PXD008361-pbs-r2) without producer transcript; producer report.md and prior review JSON contents not read; evidence re-fetched (PRIDE project + file list, Europe PMC full text PMC5796241, PBS MaxQuant parameters.txt/summary.txt via HTTP range from the PRIDE FTP zip, raw headers of PBS_P6_2xPBS.raw and PBS_QC3.raw, live OLS). Only the producer's cached supplement zip ijms-19-00296-s001.zip was reused (Europe PMC supplementaryFiles returned HTTP 500), after confirming its filename matches the paper DOI 10.3390/ijms19010296.

spec_compliance.evidence: Declared templates ms-proteomics v1.1.0 + human v1.1.0, independently confirmed as the correct set (human primary patient cells, MS proteomics, DDA; no cell lines, DIA or other experiment layers; clinical/oncology layers optional). All required base/sample-metadata/ms-proteomics/human columns present (source name, organism, organism part, biological replicate, disease, age, sex, assay name, technology type, technical replicate, data file, acquisition method, instrument, cleavage agent, label, fraction identifier). 34 columns, every row 34 fields, LF endings, ASCII, no leading/trailing whitespace, no duplicate rows or assay names. Reserved words used correctly (not available for age/sex, not applicable for QC treatment, pooled for QC biological replicate/individual). sdrf-tools structure: column order and template declaration consistent.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Live OLS4 resolution, none obsolete: NCBITaxon:9606 Homo sapiens; UBERON:0000178 blood; CL:2000001 peripheral blood mononuclear cell; MONDO:0018874 acute myeloid leukemia; MS:1002523 Q Exactive HF; MS:1001251 Trypsin; MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation; MS:1000484 orbitrap; PRIDE:0000627 Data-dependent acquisition; MS:1002038 label free sample; UNIMOD:4 Carbamidomethyl, UNIMOD:35 Oxidation, UNIMOD:1 Acetyl (labels match NT values). sdrf-tools check: 12/12 verified, 0 hallucinated/mismatch/wrong-ontology/UNIMOD swaps. characteristics[treatment] values are free text (no NCIT/EFO term encodes a PBS wash count; EFO:0000735 'washing' exists but cannot distinguish 0/1/2 washes) - optional column, warning-level only.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE: Homo sapiens, Q Exactive (PBS arm), FASP, LFQ, 'one aliquot ... control (0xPBS) ... 1xPBS ... 2xPBS', 'A pool containing equal amounts of all the samples ... QC ... analyzed three times'. Paper 4.1: six AML patient samples, peripheral blood with high blast counts, density-gradient (Lymphoprep) mononuclear cells >=95% leukemic blasts, cryopreserved; split into two or three aliquots, unwashed or 1-2 PBS washes; 4.4: Q Exactive HF, 195 min gradient, MaxQuant 1.5.5.1, CAM fixed, Ox/Protein N-term Acetyl variable, trypsin. Table S1: P1 and P4 have no 2nd wash, matching the missing PBS_P1_2xPBS/PBS_P4_2xPBS. Figure S1: 'QC1-3 are pools of P1-P6 samples'. Raw headers (PBS_P6_2xPBS, PBS_QC3, independent of the producer's two files): 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS', method Sensitive_TOP12HCD_120K-30K, TopN 12, NCE 28, scan range 375 to 1500 m/z. parameters.txt: MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm, Fixed Carbamidomethyl (C); summary.txt: Trypsin, Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term), multiplicity 1 for all 19 runs. Trypsin as digest reagent: paper 'Trypsin was used as digestion protease' and cited FASP protocol (Hernandez-Valladares 2016, PMC4915068) digests with trypsin 1:50.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE /files: 45 entries (43 RAW + 2 SEARCH zips), all projectAccessions == [PXD008361]. This SDRF lists the 19 PBS_*.raw files, each once, all present in PRIDE; the sibling annotations/PXD008361-storage.sdrf.tsv lists the 24 RW_*.raw files; union = all 43 RAW files exactly once, no overlap, no extras, no non-raw files. assay name == data file stem on every row; the same 19 runs are the raw files in the PBS MaxQuant summary.txt (experiments P1_0xPBS ... QC3).

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 16 patient samples (P1 x2, P2 x3, P3 x3, P4 x2, P5 x3, P6 x3) + 3 QC injections = 19 rows. factor value[treatment] equals characteristics[treatment] on every row: no PBS wash 6, 1 PBS wash 6, 2 PBS washes 4, not applicable 3 (QC). Sample-to-file mapping is read directly from run names / MaxQuant experiment names, not inferred: individual P<n> and biological replicate <n> match the file token on every patient row, source names unique per patient x wash. Paired design (paper uses paired t-tests) is preserved by numbering biological replicate by patient. QC: one pooled source with technical replicates 1-3, biological replicate 'pooled'. Single fraction, label free, one instrument; no confounders introduced.

omission_safety.evidence: No value asserts more than the evidence: instrument raised from PRIDE 'Q Exactive' to Q Exactive HF only on raw-header and paper evidence; disease AML (paper) rather than PRIDE 'Acute leukemia' is supported by the paper; PBMC matches the density-gradient mononuclear fraction; age/sex left not available (paper and Table S1 give none); ancestry, developmental stage and precursor tolerance omitted rather than guessed (MaxQuant 1.5 parameters.txt has no precursor tolerance; no mqpar.xml). Searched paper for sex/age/karyotype/mutation per patient - none given. Material omitted from the evidence (Table S1 cell counts, RBC contamination) is optional and noted as minor.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics --use_ols_cache_only: exit 0, only 3 warnings (free-text treatment terms not in ncit;efo). parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t human --use_ols_cache_only: exit 0, same 3 warnings. sdrf-tools check: exit 0, CLEAN (12/12). sdrf-tools score: exit 0, 96/100 (missing recommended precursor mass tolerance, ancestry category, developmental stage). sdrf-tools structure: exit 0, OK. sdrf-tools reconcile --record (fresh PRIDE record): exit 1 with two heuristic flags, both adjudicated false positives: (1) disease_on_control_runs - the 'control' token is the 0xPBS processing control / PBS buffer, every sample is from an AML patient (paper 4.1, PRIDE protocol), no healthy arm exists; (2) cleavage_agent_unsupported - PRIDE data-processing text and paper name trypsin, and the cited FASP protocol (PMC4915068) digests with trypsin. SHA-256 re-checked unchanged before writing.

findings.message: Treatment levels are free text ('no PBS wash', '1 PBS wash', '2 PBS washes') and raise 3 validator warnings.
findings.evidence: No NCIT/EFO term encodes a PBS wash count; EFO:0000735 'washing' exists but cannot separate the levels. Acceptable for an optional column; optionally reference EFO:0000735 in a future spec-supported way.

findings.message: QC pool uses 'pooled' although its sources are known, and age/sex 'not available' rather than the spec TIP's 'pooled'.
findings.evidence: README pooled-samples section: 'pooled' = sources unknown, SN= list when known; TIP suggests 'pooled' for age/sex. Pool composition (all 16 PBS samples per PRIDE, 'pools of P1-P6' per Figure S1) is documented in the manifest; current values validate and are not wrong.

findings.message: Recommended comment[precursor mass tolerance], characteristics[ancestry category] and characteristics[developmental stage] are absent.
findings.evidence: No source reports them (MaxQuant 1.5 parameters.txt lacks precursor tolerance; paper/Table S1 give no demographics); omission is safer than guessing. sdrf-tools score 96/100.

findings.message: Per-patient sample descriptors from Table S1 (cell number per sample, RBC contamination grade) are not encoded.
findings.evidence: Table S1: P1/8M moderate RBC, P2/ND high, P3/8M minimal, P4/8M high, P5/30M high, P6/10M none. Optional; could be added as characteristics if the curators want them.

findings.location: evidence manifest, claim for comment[proteomics data acquisition method]
findings.message: Claim cites raw method names 'TOP12CID / TOP12HCD', but the PBS raw files carry only Sensitive_TOP12HCD; the CID method belongs to the sibling Orbitrap Elite storage arm.
findings.evidence: Raw headers of PBS_P6_2xPBS.raw and PBS_QC3.raw show Sensitive_TOP12HCD_120K-30K. The SDRF value (DDA) is correct; only the manifest wording is imprecise.

findings.location: comment[instrument], [collision energy], [ms1 scan range] all rows
findings.message: Acquisition settings are confirmed from raw headers of 4 of 19 files (producer 2, reviewer 2 different ones), with the rest assumed identical.
findings.evidence: All four headers identical (Q Exactive HF, TOP12HCD, NCE 28, 375-1500 m/z) and all 19 runs share the 2017-04-30_QExactiveHF_3h_PBS-wash-test folder and one MaxQuant search; risk is low.
